 Nykaa gets its beauty formula together. Can fashion follow?
 Store expansion, premiumisation and a growing customer base are driving its beauty business. Fashion, meanwhile, is showing improvement but still lacks a clear differentiator.
 Hiral Goyal 9 November, 2026 • 10 min 0 9 November, 2026 • 10 min 0 More in Internet
 Internet Unethical NBFCs are running a debt-trap business in the garb of instant loans Lokesh Choudhary Internet Unethical NBFCs are running a debt-trap business in the garb of instant loans Nykaa’s turnaround is increasingly evident in its results. Its second-quarter performance, declared late last week, was impressive. Revenue from the beauty vertical grew 27% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, while fashion, a relatively smaller business, reported its third consecutive quarter of EBITDA-level profitability. The company has also launched a Luxe store within the Nykaa Fashion app, featuring premium brands such as Prada, Versace, Roberto Cavalli, Valentino, Fendi and Michael Kors. 
 This is a marked departure from 2025, when Nykaa appeared to have lost its way. At the time, we had pointed out that the beauty business continued to struggle with sticky … 
 A web of lending platforms, NBFCs and recovery agencies is turning small, short-term loans into a predatory business that the regulator is struggling to contain.
